title: Particles · Air, fight effects and elements
description: The particle system (src/particles.ts, src/effects.ts, docs/graphics.md): each scene's air (pollen on the street, dust in the flat, fireflies in the patio, La Reina Bubbaloo's gloom and bubbles in her palace), then a fight frozen in time while each effect plays a few frames: a blow, a guarded blow, a hit on gum, Cardioide's cure, Análisis Parálisis, an ánima waking, No-ta's stamp, a knockout, the victory confetti, a hit of each element (fire, ice, air, energy, water, earth, light, shadow) and lasting auras.

steps.caption: Passatge Maresme: pollen drifting on the breeze
The Meridiana flat: dust motes hanging in the light
The patio at night: fireflies wandering and pulsing
La Reina Bubbaloo's palace: pink gloom and gum bubbles rising, parting around Gerard

steps.eval: window.fx = (play, frames, keep) => { const g = window.gerard.game, app = g.app; app.timeScale = 0; if (!keep) g.effects.clear(); const stage = app.root.findByName('Escenario de combate'); const models = stage.children.filter(c => c.enabled && !['Objetivo', 'Marca de tinta', 'Sello No-ta'].includes(c.name)).sort((a, b) => a.getPosition().x - b.getPosition().x); const at = (m, y = 0) => { const p = m.getPosition(); return { x: p.x, y: p.y + y, z: p.z }; }; play(g.effects, models.slice(0, 2), models.slice(2), at); for (let i = 0; i < frames; i++) app.fire('update', 1 / 60); };
fx((e, allies, foes, at) => e.impact(at(foes[1], .9), at(allies[0], .9), 1.4, { feet: at(foes[1]) }), 5)

steps.caption: A blow: flash, sparks flying on through, a ring and dust at the feet

steps.eval: fx((e, allies, foes, at) => e.impact(at(foes[1], .9), at(allies[0], .9), 1.4, { feet: at(foes[1]) }), 22)

steps.caption: A moment later: sparks skip on the floor, dust rolls out and settles

steps.eval: window.auraAt = new (window.gerard.game.app.root.getPosition().constructor)(); fx((e, allies, foes) => { const p = foes[1].getPosition(); window.auraAt.set(p.x, p.y, p.z); e.aura('fire', window.auraAt, 5, 1); const q = allies[0].getPosition(); window.auraAt2 = window.auraAt.clone().set(q.x, q.y, q.z); e.aura('ice', window.auraAt2, 5, 1.5); }, 90)
